reviewMethod: Root actually independently read all 144 complete saved bilingual pairs, selected POS/Chinese senses and corresponding full glosses/variants/English evidence in two untruncated 72-row displays. Separately read all 200 complete frozen records including all original Chinese text, source variants and POS, rank, and every evidence ID/definition/POS/lexfile/matchedLemma/match; the first 100-record response was truncated centrally, so actually recovered complete records44-58 in a separate untruncated read before claiming full coverage. Also actually read all56 specific author deferrals. Assessed natural English noun/compound use, the selected concrete sense, faithful Chinese without invented intent or efficacy, source disambiguation and botanical/animal identity. Read all author's targeted primary-identity notes. Independently verified the original SciELO paper title/intro identifying water fennel as Oenanthe javanica through its indexed publisher page (direct retry timed out, not a claimed full PDF read); checked Kew's actual Abrus precatorius common-name list and the iPlant Chinese identity. Read Smithsonian's actual Great White=Pelecanus onocrotalus and separate American White identity, and the official Chinese protected-species list naming 白鹈鹕. White croaker's Pennahia selected identity is supported by the original research abstract and author-attested official Chinese identity, not by WordNet's separate California-fish senses. Likewise water fennel and wild liquorice deliberately retain independently supported published Chinese alternatives rather than automatically inheriting a different WordNet species. No original source or author file changed, no source sentence copied, no sampled/automatic language approval. No known substantive errors found in these selected144 pairs; this does not certify every unselected canonical source sense or deferred record.
